task_template: Open the {side} drawer directly below the countertop. Left/right is relative to the robot's initial position. To give Score5, verify both facts at the final frame: (1) the TOPMOST drawer front itself has moved outward, not a drawer beneath it; (2) that same drawer remains pulled out by at least about52% of its depth. If either fact is false, use1-4 for the target's actual progress. The drawer need not reach its mechanical end stop or be released.
native_instruction_rewrite: Deterministic side extraction only; explicit native target and terminal predicate
